title: Spectrum analysis with quantum dynamical systems. II. Finite-time analysis
summary: The prequel to this work [Ng et al., Phys. Rev. A 93, 042121 (2016)] proposes the method of spectral photon counting to enhance noise spectroscopy with an optical interferometer. While the predicted enhancement over homodyne detection is promising, the results there are derived by taking an asymptotic limit of infinite observation time; their validity for a finite time remains unclear. To validate the theory, here we perform a numerical study of a finite-time model.
